## Corrector examples

Our system (corrector + detector gate) is further from the intended path than the better of no filter and One Euro in 506 of 930 test sequences (54 of 236 with marked tremor).

- `corrector_worse_1.png`: average distance ours 12.43 px, no filter 13.02 px, One Euro 4.64 px; Parkinson's, action, tremor 16.9 px, marked tremor False, mean gate 0.09
- `corrector_worse_2.png`: average distance ours 13.52 px, no filter 16.68 px, One Euro 7.46 px; Parkinson's, action, tremor 18.4 px, marked tremor False, mean gate 0.53
